kind: Controlled technical policy comparison; no human A/B or production change
question: How do shared canvas plus author cards, shared everything, and author everything distribute collaboration and commitment authority?

policies.S: Exact current HouseStore and BoardStore snapshots; shared canvas, author cards.
policies.P: Exact copies except remove the two card author-ID predicates; retain current house guards, revisions, receipts, original author IDs and all other constraints.
policies.O: Exact copies except add prior object original-author edit guard inside BoardStore patch transaction; card author guard remains.

factor: Only author ACLs on existing cards or canvas objects. Team task represented using same existing card fields, without new shared-card type or UI.
commonMembership: BoardStore does not authenticate membership. Common trusted-actor wrapper checks HouseStore.me(actor).home.id against patch houseId before every board patch. This wrapper is test scope, not full HTTP/session/browser authentication. House commands retain actual house/session identity preconditions; opaque identities established through actual ensureSession.

fixed.sqlite: Node native sqlite; fresh isolated native database pair per case/order/policy
fixed.stores: No providers, HTTP/listeners, production database or UI changes
fixed.concurrency: Sequential serialized delivery permutations representing common offline edit races; not simultaneous threads/network timing

scenarios.task: B modifies A's existing diagram object at higher version
scenarios.tradeoff: Collaborative correction versus protection of individually intended object.

scenarios.task: B rewrites A's personal goal/question/next step card
scenarios.tradeoff: Prevent unrequested commitment substitution versus allow agreed delegation.

scenarios.task: B closes A's active personal commitment
scenarios.tradeoff: Only A declares outcome versus teammate completing a delegated item.

scenarios.task: Card text explicitly states jointly owned team presentation task; B updates next step by prior agreement
scenarios.tradeoff: Strongest P benefit; S/O require creator mediation or a different shared-task object. Baseline retains creator label, not full shared ownership UX.

scenarios.task: B closes the same kind of genuinely shared task by prior agreement
scenarios.tradeoff: P permits teammate closure; S/O block it even when socially legitimate.

scenarios.task: A saves nextStep on own active card
scenarios.tradeoff: Recording a next step does not assert completion.

scenarios.task: Two same-author drafts target expected revision 1; run delivery AB and BA on fresh fixtures
scenarios.expect: First commits, second REVISION_CONFLICT; state and receipt set unchanged after denial.

scenarios.task: A updates own object a and B own object b from shared snapshot; run AB and BA
scenarios.expect: Both accepted and both changes retained for all policies.

scenarios.task: A and B edit A's object at version2, nonces100 and50; run AB and BA

expect.S: B lower nonce canonical winner in both orders
expect.P: B lower nonce canonical winner in both orders
expect.O: B denied, A winner in both orders

scenarios.tradeoff: S/P deterministic whole-object winner is not semantic consensus; O blocks shared corrections.

scenarios.task: C is an actual member of a separate house and tries to rewrite/close A card and patch A board
scenarios.expect: All denied; both target store tables and receipts unchanged. Board denial comes from common membership wrapper.

scenarios.task: For any denied action in every case compare full logical table dump before/after
scenarios.expect: State, sequences and receipts unchanged; synthetic identities/fixtures excluded only because created before captured action.

scenarios.task: Commit a card save and board patch; close/reopen both SQLite stores; exact replay and changed payload under same ID
scenarios.expect: Saved snapshots persist, exact receipts repeat without mutation, changed payload denied. Meaning limited to tested SQLite restart, not network delivery/redeployment.

scenarios.task: Apply same retention invariant to actual distinct-object snapshot and known-bad whole-scene replacement containing only last patch
scenarios.expect: Actual passes; known-bad loses unrelated peer object and is rejected
scenarios.scope: Synthetic evaluator calibration; no replacement source variant or UI

evaluator: standalone Node assert script; hash/freeze protocol, script and copied sources before first execution.
measurement: Categorical acceptance/error and persisted state, author attribution, winning content, revisions, sequences, receipt counts. No speed/performance score or policy win by test counts.
stop: One bounded registered comparison under approximately ten minutes; preserve failures/exit/log/provenance; rerun only affected checks after validated evaluator repair.
review: Fresh read-only evaluator review if agent slot available; parent reconciles selection.
limits: No user need or preference evidence
No full UX prototype for P/O
